purpose: Teach: 双眼鏡/冷や汗/有難い/北口/出だし/オリジナリティ/平地/飛び降り

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お祖父さまの、本気で、絶対、双眼鏡、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、お借りしたいわ
lines.en: Aoi, I'd absolutely love to borrow your grandfather's binoculars sometime.
lines.style: Warm, genuine request with a little laugh underneath. Soft opening. Genuine curiosity coloring the words, not demanding. Light and easy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、お店の開店時、絶対、冷や汗、絶対、いっぱいだったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, when I was opening the shop that morning, I was seriously sweating through my shirt.
lines.style: Self-deprecating half-smile in the voice. Acknowledging her own nervousness without drama. Wry but not harsh. Light pace, natural.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様の、絶対、有難い、絶対、お言葉、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、嬉しいよ
lines.en: The things customers said to me that day—it really made me happy, you know?
lines.style: Sincere and gentle. Slight catch of genuine gratitude. Unhurried. Let the warmth sit in the silence after the phrase.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、駅の、絶対、北口、絶対、近くなのよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The shop's right near the north exit of the station, actually.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, grounded. Practical information delivered without fanfare. Clear and steady, like stating a simple fact she's noticed matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、出だし、絶対、好調よね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Your shop's launch has been going really well, hasn't it? I'm genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Sincere admiration, no flattery. Observant tone—she's noticed real details. Steady pace. The kind of honest compliment that lands.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、オリジナリティ、絶対、大切にしているよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I really do care about keeping the shop's own character, you know.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not defensive, just honest about what matters to her. Slight lean into the words. Earnest but not overwrought.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、海沿いの、絶対、平地、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、お散歩、絶対、お気に入りよ
lines.en: I love taking walks along the waterfront near there—it's become my favorite spot.
lines.style: Soft contentment in the voice. Unhurried, almost reflective. The comfort of a place she's come to love. Gentle trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、高いところから、絶対、飛び降りる、絶対、夢、絶対、見ちゃった、メイちゃん
lines.en: I had this strange dream last night about jumping off something really high.
lines.style: Wry, slightly unsettled. Self-aware humor masking something unresolved. The dream sits oddly in her chest—she's telling it to let it go. Matter-of-fact delivery hiding something tender.
